name: stl-generator-toolkit
description: Generate 3D-printable STL files with build123d: woodworking jigs (circle-cutting trammel, exact angle wedges, spacing blocks, custom designs) and replacement parts from a measured original, such as a threaded light globe. A print-readiness check refuses STLs that would misprint and flags overhangs. Defaults to an Elegoo Neptune 4 Pro bed; --bed for any printer.
